request.description: Edits a draft's content or notes; issues are recomputed. `content.items[]`: `purpose`, `required`, `title`, optional `summary`, `details` (up to 5,000 characters per language); optional `policyUrl` (https). Staff only. Consent templates are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets): compliance makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then compliance publishes. The document key is the context clients ask for (e.g. `journey`, `lead_capture`). Each item's text is hashed so a record proves exactly what the person saw.
